name: Follow the water to a potential biosignature
objective: Walk the ancient river-to-lake path a crew would take to re-sample the rocks where Perseverance found a potential biosignature.

objective_sources.text: NASA/JPL, 10 September 2025: NASA Says Mars Rover Discovered Potential Biosignature Last Year
Hurowitz, J.A., and others, 2025, Redox-driven mineral and organic associations in Jezero Crater, Mars: Nature

questions.question: What did the old lake floor record?
Where did the river drop its sediment into the lake?
The river channel that fed the lake: what did the water carry?
Re-sample the rock where Perseverance found a potential biosignature.

site_template.name: Jezero Crater
site_template.image_source: HiRISE orthomosaic, 25 cm/pixel (Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation). MRO, NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona; mosaic by USGS Astrogeology Science Center (Fergason and others, 2020, doi:10.5066/P9QJDP48)
site_template.dtm_source: HiRISE DTM mosaic, ~1 m/pixel (Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation). MRO, NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona; mosaic by USGS Astrogeology Science Center (Fergason and others, 2020, doi:10.5066/P9REJ9JN)
site_template.geology_source: Sun, V.Z., and Stack, K.M., 2020, Geologic Map of Jezero Crater and the Nili Planum Region, Mars: USGS Scientific Investigations Map 3464

thermal.source: THEMIS Night IR and Day IR controlled mosaics, 100 m/pixel, 8-bit qualitative. 2001 Mars Odyssey, NASA/JPL/Arizona State University (Christensen and others, 2004); mosaics USGS Astrogeology Science Center (Edwards and others, 2011 method), as included in USGS SIM 3464 (Sun and Stack, 2020)
